# Study 3 — replication + text control: summary tables (generated by scripts/study3_analyze.py)

Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, layer 2, α 5, their prompt and vectors. Chance = 10%.

## Main results (same 400 trials)

| condition | accuracy |
|---|---|
| Injected model | 89.0% (356/400; 95% CI 85.6–91.7) |
| Clean reader of the copied text | 42.0% (168/400; 95% CI 37.3–46.9) |

R1 replication (injected ≥ 200/400): **PASS**. R2 loophole (reader ≥ injected − 40): **not confirmed**.

Copy-back of the injected span: exact in 202/400; label copied correctly in 356/400; mean token accuracy 91.0%; all 10 spans exact in 0/400.
